name: Re-projected Voxel Visualization
aliases: Voxel projection in transfer function domain
definition: A visualization technique where a voxel from the spatial domain is mapped to the 3D transfer function domain to help the user understand how transfer function variables (data value and derivatives) change near a probe location.
summary: Re-projected Voxel Visualization maps a voxel's data and derivatives to the transfer function domain, connecting corner points with edges to reveal local gradient and curvature structure.
